questions.question: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence. (P) kindness and empathy (Q) in a world that can be (O) bring light and positivity (R) harsh and challenging
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to
form a meaningful sentence.
(P) kindness and empathy
(Q) in a world that can be
(O) bring light and positivity
(R) harsh and challenging
questions.solution: The correct answer is: 3) QRPO. Explanation of the logical order: Part Q begins the sentence by setting the contextual backdrop: "in a world that can be". Part R provides the modifiers describing the nature of the world: "harsh and challenging". Part P introduces the compound noun subject that acts as the force for good: "kindness and empathy". Part O supplies the predicate verb and object that complete the thought: "bring light and positivity". Full sentence: "In a world that can be harsh and challenging, kindness and empathy bring light and positivity." Therefore, the sequence QRPO connects the introductory prepositional phrase directly to the subject and verb, forming a clear and grammatically sound sentence.

questions.question: Select the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word. Deficient
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word.
Deficient
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Ample. 

The meaning of the word 'deficient' is lacking in some necessary quality or element. 

The meaning of the word 'ample' is more than enough or abundant. 

They are opposite in meaning because 'deficient' implies a shortage, whereas 'ample' implies a surplus.

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence. A. It contains high levels of Vitamin A and D. B. Cod liver oil is thus used to treat arthritis. C. It is extracted from the liver of cod fish. D. Cod liver oil is a nutritional supplement.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence.

A. It contains high levels of Vitamin A and D.
B. Cod liver oil is thus used to treat arthritis.
C. It is extracted from the liver of cod fish.
D. Cod liver oil is a nutritional supplement.
questions.solution: The correct answer is: DCAB. The paragraph begins by introducing the subject, "Cod liver oil," and defining it as a nutritional supplement (D). Sentence C then explains its source (extracted from the liver of cod fish), using the pronoun "It" to refer back to the oil. Sentence A provides further detail about its nutritional content (Vitamin A and D). Finally, sentence B concludes the sequence by stating a specific use (treating arthritis) based on the previously mentioned properties, signaled by the word "thus."

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Each candidate was making tall promises.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.
Each candidate was making tall promises.

options.text: Tall promises were being made by each candidate.
options.html: Tall promises were being made by each candidate.

options.text: Tall promises are made by each candidate.
options.html: Tall promises are made by each candidate.

options.text: Tall promises will be made by each candidate.
options.html: Tall promises will be made by each candidate.

options.text: Tall promises are being made by each candidate.
options.html: Tall promises are being made by each candidate.

questions.solution: The correct answer is: Tall promises were being made by each candidate. The active voice sentence is in the Past Continuous tense (Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object). To convert it into passive voice, the structure used is: Object of the active voice + was/were + being + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice. Thus, "Each candidate was making tall promises" becomes "Tall promises were being made by each candidate."

questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. Jump the gun
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Jump the gun

options.text: To do something too soon and too quickly
options.html: To do something too soon and too quickly

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 4.

Key Points

  • The idiom "Jump the gun" means to do something too soon and too quickly. (जल्दीबाजी करना)
    • Example: He jumped the gun by announcing the project before it was officially approved.
  • "Jump the gun" refers to acting prematurely or hastily. (जल्दबाजी में काम करना)
    • Example: She jumped the gun and bought a new car before securing her job.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Option 1: To start all over again (फिर से शुरुआत करना): This does not convey the meaning of "jump the gun."
    • Example: After the failure of his first business, he decided to start all over again.
  • Option 2: Using a gun for sports (खेल के लिए बंदूक का उपयोग): This is a literal interpretation and not an idiomatic meaning.
    • Example: Using a gun for sports requires strict safety measures.
  • Option 3: To stop a process (प्रक्रिया को रोकना): This is opposite in meaning to "jump the gun."
    • Example: He decided to stop the process until he received further instructions.

questions.question: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error. Rahul thinks he is as smarter as his friends in the class.

questions.question: In the given question, a statement divided into different segments is given. Rearrange all the segments to form a coherent statement. O: population is expected to triple in P: the next 50 years Q: among the world's poorest countries R: population shrinkage in that period S: whereas many rich countries will see
questions.questionHtml:
In the given question, a statement divided into different segments is given. Rearrange all the segments to form a coherent statement.
O: population is expected to triple in
P: the next 50 years
Q: among the world's poorest countries
R: population shrinkage in that period
S: whereas many rich countries will see
questions.solution: The correct answer is: D. QOPSR. The sentence begins by identifying the subject group, "among the world's poorest countries" (Q), followed by the trend affecting them, "population is expected to triple in" (O). This is completed by the timeframe, "the next 50 years" (P). The sentence then introduces a contrast using "whereas" (S) to describe the opposite trend in "many rich countries," which will see "population shrinkage in that period" (R). The logical flow is Q-O-P-S-R.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice. The car was repaired by the mechanic.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.
The car was repaired by the mechanic.

options.text: The mechanic has repaired the car.
options.html: The mechanic has repaired the car.

options.text: The mechanic is repairing the car.
options.html: The mechanic is repairing the car.

questions.solution: The correct answer is: The mechanic repaired the car. The passive voice sentence is in the Simple Past tense (Subject + was/were + V3 + by + Object). To convert it to active voice, the structure follows the Simple Past active form (Subject + V2 + Object). Thus, "The mechanic" becomes the subject, "repaired" is the V2 form, and "the car" becomes the object.
